card.one_liner: 어떤 서류가 정말 청구를 막는지, 청구 기한 경계, 심사 회부와 거절의 기준.

rules.text: Claims must be filed within 3 years of the incident under the standard policy terms.
Every medical claim needs the diagnosis certificate, the itemised receipt and the account for payment.
A claim on a policy lapsed for non-payment is declined unless reinstated.
Pre-existing conditions declared at sign-up are excluded for the first 2 years.

exceptions.text: For outpatient claims under 100,000 won, the itemised receipt alone is accepted without the diagnosis certificate.
If the lapse was under 2 months and the premium is paid at claim time, the claim is processed after reinstatement, not declined.
A condition first diagnosed after sign-up is not pre-existing even if symptoms were noted earlier; the diagnosis date decides.
Partial approval above 80% pays immediately; the remainder goes to review with a 7-day target.

judgment_calls.text: When the hospital name on the certificate and the receipt differ, call the hospital before flagging; transfers between affiliated clinics are common.
A refile within 14 days with the missing document returns to the same handler, not to appeal.
A claim filed on day 1,090 of the 3-year window is accepted and flagged for fast review so the window is not lost on an internal delay.

common_mistakes.text: Rejecting a small outpatient claim for a missing certificate that is not required under 100,000 won.
Treating symptoms noted before sign-up as a pre-existing condition without a diagnosis date.
Declining a 1-month lapse instead of routing to reinstatement.

never_do.text: Never approve a claim on a policy lapsed more than 2 months; refuse and explain the reinstatement path.
Never send a first refile to appeal.
Never pay a partial approval without listing the held items.
